proposals.title: PROPOSAL 4 TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING POLITICAL CONTRIBUTIONS DISCLOSURE
proposals.proponent: Mercy Rome, c/o Newground Social Investment
proposals.topic_summary: Requests semiannual reporting on corporate policies and expenditures for electioneering and political contributions, including recipients, amounts, and decision-makers, excluding lobbying.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 5 TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A HUMAN RIGHTS IMPACT ASSESSMENT
proposals.proponent: Domini Impact Equity Fund (with co-filers Northwest & Ethical Investments L.P., Seeds Trust, Trillium ESG Global Equity Fund, IA Clarington Inhance Canadian Equity SRI Fund)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests publication of a Human Rights Impact Assessment examining actual and potential human rights impacts of cotton sourcing across the full supply chain, omitting proprietary information.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 6 TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING SUPPLEMENTAL PAY EQUITY DISCLOSURE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on median pay gaps across race and gender, including related policy, reputational, competitive, and operational risks and risks to recruiting diverse talent.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 7 TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION EFFORTS REPORTING
proposals.proponent: Wynnette LaBosse Tr, c/o As You Sow
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual reporting assessing diversity and inclusion efforts, including the Board's process for assessing program effectiveness and goals, metrics, and trends for promotion, recruitment, and retention.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal
